headline: Caixa Agências Files Lawsuit to Revise Rental Agreements with Caixa Econômica Federal
summary: Real estate investment fund Caixa Agências announced it has filed rent revision lawsuits regarding six properties leased to Caixa Econômica Federal, while also declaring a record dividend distribution.
why: Real estate investment funds (FIIs) distribute rental income to investors, making lease revisions with major tenants crucial for tracking cash flow and yield stability.

impacts.name: Caixa Agencias
impacts.why: Rent revisions can directly alter the underlying revenue and distribution yields of real estate funds.
